privacySeoDesc: TradifyApp's Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your trading data and personal information. GDPR compliant.
privacyIntro: This Privacy Policy describes how TradifyApp ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and shares information about you when you use our trading journal application and related services (collectively, the "Service"). By using the Service, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.
privacyS1aItem1: Email address, username, and password when you create an account.
privacyS1aItem2: Optional profile details you choose to provide.
privacyS1aItem3: Billing details processed through PayPal (we do not store full payment card details).
privacyS1aItem4: Trade entries, notes, strategies, and performance metrics you input manually.
privacyS1aItem5: Messages sent to our support team or through contact forms.
privacyS1bItem1: Account balance, equity, trade history, and performance metrics synced from your MetaTrader 5 accounts.
privacyS1bItem2: Features accessed, pages viewed, and interactions with the Service.
privacyS1bItem3: Browser type, operating system, and device identifiers.
privacyS1bItem4: IP addresses, access times, and referring URLs.
privacyS1bItem5: Session cookies for authentication and preferences.
privacyS2Body: We use the collected information for the following purposes:
privacyS2Item1: To provide, maintain, and improve the trading journal functionality.
privacyS2Item2: To create and manage your account, process subscriptions, and handle billing.
privacyS2Item3: To generate performance metrics, statistics, and insights for your dashboard.
privacyS2Item4: To send service updates, security alerts, and support responses.
privacyS2Item5: To understand usage patterns and enhance user experience.
privacyS2Item6: To detect, prevent, and address fraud, abuse, and technical issues.
privacyS2Item7: To comply with applicable laws and regulatory requirements.
privacyS3Body: We do NOT sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We may share data only in these circumstances:
privacyS3Item1: Third-party vendors who assist in operating our Service (e.g., PayPal for payments, email providers for transactional emails).
privacyS3Item2: When required by law, court order, or governmental authority.
privacyS3Item3: To protect the rights, property, or safety of TradifyApp, our users, or others.
privacyS3Item4: In connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets (with notice to users).
privacyS3Item5: When you explicitly authorize us to share specific information.
privacyS4Body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information:
privacyS4Item1: All data transmitted between your browser and our servers is encrypted using TLS/SSL.
privacyS4Item2: Passwords are hashed using secure algorithms and never stored in plain text.
privacyS4Item3: Limited access to personal data on a need-to-know basis.
privacyS4Item4: Periodic security assessments and vulnerability testing.
privacyS4Item5: Hosted on secure, monitored cloud infrastructure.
privacyS4Note: However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security of your data.
privacyS5Item1: We retain your data as long as your account is active.
privacyS5Item2: Retention varies by subscription tier (Free: 30 days, Pro: 1 year, Elite: Unlimited).
privacyS5Item3: Upon account deletion request, we remove personal data within 30 days, except where retention is required by law.
privacyS5Item4: Encrypted backups may retain data for up to 90 days after deletion.
privacyS5Item5: Some data may be retained longer to comply with legal or regulatory requirements.
privacyS6Body: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights:
privacyS6Item1: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
privacyS6Item2: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
privacyS6Item3: Request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten").
privacyS6Item4: Request export of your data in a machine-readable format.
privacyS6Item5: Unsubscribe from marketing communications at any time.
privacyS6Item6: Request limitation of how we use your data.
privacyS6Item7: Withdraw previously given consent for data processing.
privacyS6Note: To exercise these rights, contact us at support@tradifyapp.com.
privacyS7Item1: Required for authentication and core functionality.
privacyS7Item3: We may use anonymized analytics to understand usage patterns.
privacyS7Note: You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences. Disabling essential cookies may affect Service functionality.
privacyS8Body: Our Service integrates with third-party services that have their own privacy policies:
privacyS8Item2: Trade data synchronization (data is fetched from your MT5 account).
privacyS8Item3: AI-powered features for Pro/Elite users (queries are anonymized).
privacyS8Note: We encourage you to review the privacy policies of these third-party services.
privacyS9Body: For users in the European Economic Area (EEA), United Kingdom, and similar jurisdictions, we process your personal data based on the following lawful grounds:
privacyS9Item1: Processing required to provide the Service you signed up for (account management, trade journaling, MT5 sync, subscription management).
privacyS9Item2: Where you have given explicit consent for specific processing activities (marketing emails, analytics cookies, optional data sharing). You may withdraw consent at any time.
privacyS9Item3: Processing necessary for our legitimate business interests (security, fraud prevention, service improvement), provided these interests are not overridden by your rights.
privacyS9Item4: Processing required to comply with applicable laws, regulations, or legal proceedings.
privacyS10Body: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence, including the United States. When we transfer data outside the EEA/UK, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, including:
privacyS10Item1: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission.
privacyS10Item2: Transfers to countries with adequacy decisions from the European Commission.
privacyS10Item3: Other legally recognized transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws.
privacyS11Body: In addition to the rights listed in Section 6, users in the EEA/UK and California have specific additional rights:
privacyS11GdprItem1: Object to processing based on legitimate interest or for direct marketing purposes.
privacyS11GdprItem2Bold: Right Not to Be Subject to Automated Decisions:
privacyS11GdprItem2: You will not be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing, including profiling, that produce legal or similarly significant effects.
privacyS11GdprItem3: You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection supervisory authority if you believe your data rights have been violated.
privacyS11CcpaItem1: Request disclosure of the categories and specific pieces of personal information we have collected.
privacyS11CcpaItem2: Request deletion of personal information we have collected.
privacyS11CcpaItem3: We will not discriminate against you for exercising your CCPA rights.
privacyS11CcpaItem4: We do not sell your personal information as defined by the CCPA.
privacyS11Note: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at support@tradifyapp.com. We will respond within 30 days (GDPR) or 45 days (CCPA).
privacyS12Body: The Service is not intended for individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that we have collected data from a child under 18, we will take steps to delete such information promptly. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us.
privacyS13Body: In the event of a personal data breach that is likely to result in a high risk to your rights and freedoms, we will:
privacyS13Item1: Notify the relevant supervisory authority within 72 hours of becoming aware of the breach (where required by law).
privacyS13Item2: Notify affected users without undue delay when the breach is likely to result in a high risk to their rights and freedoms.
privacyS13Item3: Document the nature of the breach, its likely effects, and the measures taken to address it.
privacyS14Item1: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices.
privacyS14Item2: Material changes will be communicated via email or prominent notice on the Service at least 30 days before taking effect.
privacyS14Item3: Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacyS14Item4: The "Last updated" date at the top indicates when the policy was last revised.
privacyS15Body: If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
privacyS15Note: For GDPR-related inquiries, you may also contact your local data protection supervisory authority.
privacyAcknowledgment: By using TradifyApp, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy and agree to the collection, use, and disclosure of your information as described herein.
riskSeoDesc: Important risk disclosure for TradifyApp users. Trading forex and CFDs involves substantial risk. Read our full risk disclaimer before trading.
riskWarningBody: Trading foreign exchange (Forex), contracts for difference (CFDs), cryptocurrencies, and other financial instruments on margin carries a high level of risk and may not be suitable for all investors. The high degree of leverage available in these markets can work against you as well as for you. Before deciding to trade, you should carefully consider your investment objectives, level of experience, and risk appetite.

riskS1Item4: High volatility in financial markets can result in significant and rapid losses.

cookiesIntro: This Cookie Policy explains how TradifyApp ("we", "us", or "our") uses cookies and similar technologies to recognize you when you visit our website. It explains what these technologies are, why we use them, and your rights to control our use of them.
cookiesS1Body1: Cookies are small data files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. Cookies are widely used by website owners to make their websites work, or to work more efficiently, as well as to provide reporting information.
cookiesS1Body2: Cookies set by the website owner (in this case, TradifyApp) are called "first-party cookies". Cookies set by parties other than the website owner are called "third-party cookies". Third-party cookies enable third-party features or functionality to be provided on or through the website (e.g., advertising, interactive content, and analytics).
cookiesEssentialBody: These cookies are essential for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in, or filling in forms.
cookiesEssentialItem1: Maintain your login state and authentication
cookiesEssentialItem2: Protect against fraud and unauthorized access
cookiesAnalyticsBody: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site.
cookiesAnalyticsItem1: Collects anonymous data about how you use our website
cookiesAnalyticsItem2: Helps us identify and fix issues
cookiesAnalyticsItem3: Understand which features are most valuable
cookiesMarketingBody: These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant advertisements on other sites.
cookiesMarketingItem1: Measures ad effectiveness and enables retargeting
cookiesMarketingItem2: Serves relevant advertisements based on your interests
cookiesS3Body1: You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject cookies. You can exercise your cookie preferences by clicking the "Manage Cookie Preferences" button above.
cookiesS3Body2: You can also set or amend your web browser controls to accept or refuse cookies. If you choose to reject cookies, you may still use our website though your access to some functionality and areas of our website may be restricted.
cookiesS4Item1: Deleted when you close your browser
cookiesS4Item2: Remain on your device for a set period (typically 1-2 years) or until you delete them
cookiesS5Body: Some cookies are placed by third-party services that appear on our pages. We do not control the setting of these cookies, so we suggest you check the third-party websites for more information about their cookies and how to manage them:
cookiesS6Body: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time in order to reflect changes to the cookies we use or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. Please revisit this Cookie Policy regularly to stay informed about our use of cookies.
cookiesS7Body: If you have any questions about our use of cookies or other technologies, please contact us:
